Results-driven Trade Processing & Custody Operations Professional with over 8 years of experience in Investment Banking Operations, Securities Settlement, Cash Processing, and Reconciliation. Expert in SWIFT messaging (MT54X, MT103, MT202, MT599), Middle Office operations, and global market settlements. Proven leader in process improvement using Agile project management practices, including Sprint Planning and User Story documentation. Recognized for high accuracy, SLA compliance, and client satisfaction in high-volume, deadline-driven environments.

Office Operations.

Resolution, Exception Management.

Funding & Repatriation (DVP/RVP), FX Processing.
Compliance: Corporate Actions Support, Client Servicing, Audit Support, MIS

Documentation, UAT & SIT Coordination, Process Improvement, Stakeholder Management.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Standard Chartered Bank GBS | Team Leader, Custody Operations & Trade Processing
Jan 2024 – Present | Chennai
Lead Custody Operations and Trade Processing for Middle East markets, overseeing securities settlement and pre-matching.
Execute trade capture and instruction amendments (MT540–MT543) while validating client instructions against SWIFT standards.
Manage the end-to-end settlement lifecycle using TCS BaNCS, including repair, release, and confirmation (MT544–MT548).
Perform funding and repatriation for DVP/RVP trades utilizing MT103/MT202 messages and internal transfers.
Conduct daily cash and trade reconciliations, investigating breaks and resolving exceptions within defined SLAs.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning and Daily Scrum meetings, to track system enhancements.
Develop User Stories and functional requirements to drive automation and workflow optimization.
Coordinate UAT, UVT, and SIT testing for new system releases to ensure seamless production deployment.
Collaborate with external counterparties, such as HSBC, for payment processing and trade matching.
Maintain strict adherence to Departmental Operating Instructions (DOI), risk controls, and audit standards.
State Street HCL Services | Specialist / SME, Trade & Cash Operations
Jul 2018 – Oct 2023 | Chennai
Directed transaction services for trade processing and securities settlement through MT54X manual processing and broker confirmations.
Key contributor to process migration and knowledge transition, ensuring zero business disruption during onshore-to-offshore moves.
Championed automation and transformation initiatives to reduce manual intervention in reconciliation workflows.
Supported change management by documenting SOPs and training team members on new system enhancements.
Participated in Agile-driven operational transformation projects through Sprint Planning and Daily Scrum meetings.
Drafted User Stories and functional documentation for reconciliation process improvements.
Managed hyper-care client operations, including pre-funding and MT599 messaging support during transition phases.
Processed same-day settlement transactions for DTC, Canada, and FED markets, including Repo and Reverse Repo trades.
Executed cash instructions (MT103, MT202, MT202COV) and ensured accurate SSI validation.
Utilized SmartStream TLM for daily reconciliation, performing root cause analysis on failed trades and settlement breaks.
Produced MIS reports and reconciliation dashboards to update senior management on transformation progress.
Partnered with Reference Data and Technology teams to support system migration and automation delivery.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Achievers League Trophy: Received for four consecutive years (2019–2022) for top performance and consistent SLA delivery.
Client Appreciation: Honored for maintaining high settlement accuracy and delivering issue-free operations.
